scientific_specification.primary_question: Across the 12 canonical Ocean Sentinel taxonomy classes on the 256x256 (100m pixel, 25.6x25.6 km) grid, does the canonical ResNet18-UNet baseline architecture provide spatial and receptive-field scales (multi-path theoretical receptive fields from 19 pixels along shallow skip paths to 531-563 pixels through the bottleneck, and 32-pixel / 3.2 km encoder bottleneck sampling scale) that are demonstrably compatible, incompatible, or uncertain relative to the observed spatial structure and boundary extents of annotated connected components in the canonical training/development masks?

prior_diagnostics_closure.DIAG-01: COMPLETED_VALID (CASE B: Support-sensitive but valid frozen metric on OPS-02 DEV)
prior_diagnostics_closure.DIAG-02: COMPLETED_FORENSICALLY_REPAIRED (Sampler exposure schedule bounded on OPS-02 TRAIN)
prior_diagnostics_closure.DIAG-03: COMPLETED (Radiometric discriminability characterized on OPS-02 TRAIN + DEV; 1-D radiometric overlap motivates evaluating whether spatial context provides additional discriminative information; 1-D radiometry alone does not uniquely separate several observed class distributions)

scale_hypotheses.description: Large mesoscale phenomena (MCC, AF, Eddy, LWA) frequently touch the 25.6 km tile boundary (EDGE_CENSORED_OBSERVATION), bounding their observable extent within single crops.
scale_hypotheses.test: Quantify boundary intersection rate across parent scenes; compare uncensored vs censored size distributions.

scale_hypotheses.description: Compact annotated components (HM: 1-3 pixels, point-like RF) fall below the 32-pixel (3.2 km) encoder bottleneck sampling stride, relying on shallow skip connections for fine spatial localization.
scale_hypotheses.test: Component equivalent diameter distribution vs multi-path receptive fields and bottleneck sampling interval.

scale_hypotheses.description: Structured classes (IWs, POW, WS, MCC) exhibit spatial layout periodicity in human annotation masks that can be compared against architectural receptive field envelopes.
scale_hypotheses.test: 2D radial power spectral density and autocorrelation of binary masks with multi-taper peak stability checks, explicitly categorized as annotation layout morphology.

evidence_levels.OBSERVED: Direct mathematical or geometric measurement on data or architecture
evidence_levels.SUPPORTED: Descriptive correspondence backed by multiple geometric and architectural metrics
evidence_levels.PLAUSIBLE: Hypothesis logically consistent with observations but not definitively established
evidence_levels.CAUSAL_ESTABLISHED: STRICTLY PROHIBITED in DIAG-04 (observational/architectural design cannot establish performance causation)

scale_taxonomy.data_window_scale: 256 x 256 pixels = 25.6 x 25.6 km (Observation aperture; border contact designates EDGE_CENSORED_OBSERVATION)
scale_taxonomy.architectural_sampling_scale: 32 pixels = 3.2 km (Encoder bottleneck feature map grid spacing; not a hard detection limit)
scale_taxonomy.architectural_receptive_field_scale: Multi-scale spectrum from 19 pixels (shallow skip) to 531-563 pixels (deepest bottleneck path) (TRF)
scale_taxonomy.observed_annotation_scale: Geometric dimensions of annotated connected components in the raster mask
scale_taxonomy.inferred_physical_scale: True physical scale of oceanographic phenomenon in nature (requires external domain metadata)

statistical_design.component_extraction_semantics: Exhaustive descriptive enumeration across finite dataset, not independent i.i.d. observations

sparsity_rules.k_equals_one: Descriptive only; suppress between-cluster confidence intervals (OF, RF)
sparsity_rules.k_equals_two: Mark with extreme uncertainty caveat; descriptive only (BS, WS, Eddy)

architecture_specification.crop_clipping_policy: Usable context is strictly clipped by the 256x256 crop aperture; theoretical dependency exceeding 256 px is zero-padded or swath-masked (LL-EXP07-028)

effective_receptive_field_policy.reason: Learned-weight sensitivity requires backward passes, violating BLOCK-006 (backward_passes == 0)
effective_receptive_field_policy.analytical_proxy_mode: ANALYTICAL_LUO_GAUSSIAN (Descriptive architectural proxy under random i.i.d. weights)

contingency_policy.all_components_touch_boundary: Report uncensored size distribution as EMPTY; flag class as fully censored
contingency_policy.class_contains_only_tiny_components: Report discrete pixel histogram; analyze overlap with 19-px skip RF vs 32-px bottleneck stride
contingency_policy.insufficient_cluster_support: K=1: descriptive only, suppress CIs; K=2: flag extreme uncertainty
contingency_policy.disconnected_components_unmapped: Treat 8-connected polygons strictly as annotated connected components; do not apply heuristic grouping
contingency_policy.psd_has_no_stable_peak: Classify as BROADBAND_MONOTONIC; report spectral decay slope; do not force harmonic peak
contingency_policy.psd_peak_changes_with_windowing: Report peak sensitivity range; flag spatial periodicity as windowing artifact
contingency_policy.analytical_proxy_disagrees_with_trf: Report both values; explain distinction between theoretical support and Gaussian proxy
contingency_policy.multi_path_architecture_dependency: Report multi-scale profile across all 5 paths; do not reduce architecture to single scalar RF
contingency_policy.architecture_differs_from_roadmap: Correct plan artifacts to authoritative implementation values (Layer 4 TRF = 435 px)
contingency_policy.metric_cannot_support_interpretation: Re-label metric to true descriptive scope; state boundaries explicitly
